symbols.name: Robed figure
symbols.gloss: an adult in long robes, gown or cloak (priest, monarch, hermit, sibyl)
symbols.declared_text: the Hierophant 'in the full vestment of his office' — established order, doctrine

attestations.note: the Hierophant 'in the full vestment of his office' — established order, doctrine

symbols.name: Nude figure
symbols.gloss: an unclothed human figure
symbols.declared_text: the Star: 'the figure ... is entirely naked' — truth unveiled, nothing withheld

attestations.note: the Star: 'the figure ... is entirely naked' — truth unveiled, nothing withheld

symbols.name: Child
symbols.gloss: a child or infant
symbols.declared_text: the Sun: 'a naked child ... the simplicity and innocence of a new age'

attestations.note: the Sun: 'a naked child ... the simplicity and innocence of a new age'

symbols.name: Pair of figures
symbols.gloss: exactly two figures in relation (lovers, captives, twins, the falling)
symbols.declared_text: the Lovers: 'attraction, love, beauty, trials overcome' — the bond between two

attestations.note: the Lovers: 'attraction, love, beauty, trials overcome' — the bond between two
the Devil: two chained figures — the pair bound together

symbols.name: Group of figures
symbols.gloss: three or more figures together
symbols.declared_text: Judgement: the rising 'of all the dead' — the collective called

attestations.note: Judgement: the rising 'of all the dead' — the collective called

symbols.name: Winged figure
symbols.gloss: an angel, cupid or other winged human figure
symbols.declared_text: Temperance: 'a winged angel' pouring the essences of life — mediation, giving

attestations.note: Temperance: 'a winged angel' pouring the essences of life — mediation, giving
Judgement: the angel's summons — a change that is not chosen

symbols.name: Horned devil
symbols.gloss: a horned, winged devil on a pedestal with chained captives
symbols.declared_text: the Devil: 'ravage, violence, vehemence, extraordinary efforts, force, fatality' — bondage

attestations.note: the Devil: 'ravage, violence, vehemence, extraordinary efforts, force, fatality' — bondage

symbols.name: Skeleton
symbols.gloss: a skeleton or skeletal rider
symbols.declared_text: Death: 'end, mortality, destruction, corruption' — the ending no one negotiates

attestations.note: Death: 'end, mortality, destruction, corruption' — the ending no one negotiates

symbols.name: Seated figure
symbols.gloss: the main figure is enthroned or seated
symbols.declared_text: the Emperor: 'stability, power, protection' — authority that does not move

attestations.note: the Emperor: 'stability, power, protection' — authority that does not move

symbols.name: Walking figure
symbols.gloss: a figure in mid-stride, travelling
symbols.declared_text: the Fool: 'a prince of the other world on his travels' — setting out

attestations.note: the Fool: 'a prince of the other world on his travels' — setting out

symbols.name: Inverted figure
symbols.gloss: a figure hanging upside down
symbols.declared_text: the Hanged Man: 'wisdom, circumspection, trials, sacrifice' — suspension, reversal

attestations.note: the Hanged Man: 'wisdom, circumspection, trials, sacrifice' — suspension, reversal

symbols.name: Raised arm
symbols.gloss: an arm lifted: blessing, invocation, holding something aloft
symbols.declared_text: the Magician: 'one hand upraised' drawing down power — will directed outward

attestations.note: the Magician: 'one hand upraised' drawing down power — will directed outward
the Hierophant's 'sign of esotericism' — the blessing given

symbols.name: Sun
symbols.gloss: the sun, a sunburst, or a radiant nimbus
symbols.declared_text: the Sun: 'material happiness, fortunate marriage, contentment'

attestations.note: the Sun: 'material happiness, fortunate marriage, contentment'

symbols.name: Moon
symbols.gloss: the moon, crescent or full
symbols.declared_text: the Moon: 'hidden enemies, danger, calumny, darkness, terror, deception, occult forces'

attestations.note: the Moon: 'hidden enemies, danger, calumny, darkness, terror, deception, occult forces'

symbols.name: Star
symbols.gloss: one or more stars
symbols.declared_text: the Star: 'hope and bright prospects' — 'the gifts of the spirit'

attestations.note: the Star: 'hope and bright prospects' — 'the gifts of the spirit'

symbols.name: Falling water
symbols.gloss: water poured from a vessel or cascading downward
symbols.declared_text: the Star: 'pouring Water of Life' from two vessels — release, giving freely

attestations.note: the Star: 'pouring Water of Life' from two vessels — release, giving freely
Temperance: the flow 'from chalice to chalice' — measured giving

symbols.name: Pool or river
symbols.gloss: still or standing water: pool, lake, river, sea
symbols.declared_text: the Moon: the crayfish rising from the pool — 'the nameless and hideous tendency' below the surface

attestations.note: the Moon: the crayfish rising from the pool — 'the nameless and hideous tendency' below the surface
the Star: the great pool 'of the waters of life'

symbols.name: Mountains
symbols.gloss: mountains or crags in the landscape
symbols.declared_text: the Hermit on the heights — attainment reached alone

attestations.note: the Hermit on the heights — attainment reached alone
the Emperor's barren mountains: 'the sterile regulation' of power

symbols.name: Tower
symbols.gloss: a tower or towers
symbols.declared_text: the Tower: 'misery, distress, indigence, adversity, calamity, disgrace, deception, ruin'

attestations.note: the Tower: 'misery, distress, indigence, adversity, calamity, disgrace, deception, ruin'

symbols.name: Pillars
symbols.gloss: columns, posts or uprights framing the figure
symbols.declared_text: the High Priestess between 'the pillars J. and B.' — the threshold of the sanctuary

attestations.note: the High Priestess between 'the pillars J. and B.' — the threshold of the sanctuary

symbols.name: Veil or canopy
symbols.gloss: a veil, curtain or canopy
symbols.declared_text: the High Priestess: 'secrets, mystery, the future as yet unrevealed' behind the veil

attestations.note: the High Priestess: 'secrets, mystery, the future as yet unrevealed' behind the veil
Justice: the curtain behind the throne — what is not shown

symbols.name: Wheel
symbols.gloss: a great wheel
symbols.declared_text: Wheel of Fortune: 'destiny, fortune, success, elevation, luck, felicity' — turning without our consent

attestations.note: Wheel of Fortune: 'destiny, fortune, success, elevation, luck, felicity' — turning without our consent

symbols.name: Dog
symbols.gloss: a dog, wolf or dog-like animal
symbols.declared_text: the Fool: the dog 'still bounding' at his side — instinct, companionship

attestations.note: the Fool: the dog 'still bounding' at his side — instinct, companionship
the Moon: 'the dog and wolf' — 'the fears of the natural mind'

symbols.name: Lion
symbols.gloss: a lion or lion-bodied creature (sphinx)
symbols.declared_text: Strength: 'power, energy, action, courage, magnanimity'

attestations.note: Strength: 'power, energy, action, courage, magnanimity'

symbols.name: Horse
symbols.gloss: a horse
symbols.declared_text: Death: 'a mysterious horseman moves slowly' — the advance that cannot be stopped

attestations.note: Death: 'a mysterious horseman moves slowly' — the advance that cannot be stopped

symbols.name: Bird
symbols.gloss: a bird or eagle (including heraldic)
symbols.declared_text: the Star: 'a bird alights' on the tree — the spirit alighting, message from above

attestations.note: the Star: 'a bird alights' on the tree — the spirit alighting, message from above

symbols.name: Trees
symbols.gloss: one or more trees
symbols.declared_text: the Lovers: 'the Tree of Life' and 'the Tree of the Knowledge' — growth and its price

attestations.note: the Lovers: 'the Tree of Life' and 'the Tree of the Knowledge' — growth and its price
the Hanged Man: 'the living wood' of the gallows — sacrifice that still grows

symbols.name: Flowers
symbols.gloss: roses, lilies, sunflowers, irises
symbols.declared_text: the Magician: 'roses and lilies' — 'the culture of aspiration'

attestations.note: the Magician: 'roses and lilies' — 'the culture of aspiration'
the Sun: sunflowers over the wall — flourishing

symbols.name: Wreath
symbols.gloss: a wreath, garland or mandorla of leaves
symbols.declared_text: the World: 'assured success, recompense, voyage, route' — completion

attestations.note: the World: 'assured success, recompense, voyage, route' — completion
Strength: the 'chain of flowers' — gentleness that binds

symbols.name: Crown
symbols.gloss: a crown, tiara or crowned head
symbols.declared_text: the Emperor: 'the crown ... of executive and realization' — authority

attestations.note: the Emperor: 'the crown ... of executive and realization' — authority

symbols.name: Wand or staff
symbols.gloss: a wand, staff, sceptre or rod
symbols.declared_text: the Magician's wand: 'skill, diplomacy, address ... will'

attestations.note: the Magician's wand: 'skill, diplomacy, address ... will'

symbols.name: Sword or blade
symbols.gloss: a sword, knife or scythe blade
symbols.declared_text: Justice: the sword of decision — 'equity, rightness, probity'

attestations.note: Justice: the sword of decision — 'equity, rightness, probity'

symbols.name: Cup or vessel
symbols.gloss: a cup, chalice, jug or vessel
symbols.declared_text: Temperance: 'from chalice to chalice' — measured exchange

attestations.note: Temperance: 'from chalice to chalice' — measured exchange
the Magician's cup on the table — the receptive instrument

symbols.name: Scales
symbols.gloss: a balance / pair of scales
symbols.declared_text: Justice: 'equity, rightness, probity, executive' — weighed and settled

attestations.note: Justice: 'equity, rightness, probity, executive' — weighed and settled

symbols.name: Lantern
symbols.gloss: a lantern or lamp held up
symbols.declared_text: the Hermit: 'where I am, you also may be' — the lamp of the solitary seeker

attestations.note: the Hermit: 'where I am, you also may be' — the lamp of the solitary seeker

symbols.name: Trumpet
symbols.gloss: a trumpet sounded
symbols.declared_text: Judgement: 'the great angel ... blowing his bannered trumpet' — the summons

attestations.note: Judgement: 'the great angel ... blowing his bannered trumpet' — the summons

symbols.name: Banner
symbols.gloss: a banner, flag or standard
symbols.declared_text: the Sun: the child's 'red standard' — proclamation of new life

attestations.note: the Sun: the child's 'red standard' — proclamation of new life
Death's banner with the Mystic Rose — the sign carried before

symbols.name: Book or scroll
symbols.gloss: an open book or scroll
symbols.declared_text: the High Priestess: 'the scroll ... signifies the Greater Law' — knowledge partly hidden

attestations.note: the High Priestess: 'the scroll ... signifies the Greater Law' — knowledge partly hidden

symbols.name: Flames
symbols.gloss: fire, flames or a torch
symbols.declared_text: the Tower: flames of the lightning-struck house

attestations.note: the Tower: flames of the lightning-struck house
the Lovers: 'the tree of flame' — passion, the twelve fruits

symbols.name: Lightning
symbols.gloss: lightning or fire striking from the sky
symbols.declared_text: the Tower: 'the lightning flash' — sudden, unchosen ending

attestations.note: the Tower: 'the lightning flash' — sudden, unchosen ending

symbols.name: Chariot
symbols.gloss: a chariot or car
symbols.declared_text: the Chariot: 'succour, providence; also war, triumph, presumption, vengeance, trouble'

attestations.note: the Chariot: 'succour, providence; also war, triumph, presumption, vengeance, trouble'

symbols.name: Table
symbols.gloss: a table or altar with implements laid out
symbols.declared_text: the Magician: 'on the table in front ... the four Tarot suits' — the means at hand

attestations.note: the Magician: 'on the table in front ... the four Tarot suits' — the means at hand

symbols.name: Lemniscate
symbols.gloss: a figure-of-eight sign, or a wide hat shaped as one
symbols.declared_text: the Magician: 'the sign of life ... the endless cord' above the head

attestations.note: the Magician: 'the sign of life ... the endless cord' above the head
Strength: the lemniscate 'over the head of the woman' — sustained mastery

symbols.name: Path or road
symbols.gloss: a track, road or river-way leading into the distance
symbols.declared_text: a way forward: departure, the journey ahead

attestations.note: the Moon: 'the path… between the two towers' (Waite 1911)

symbols.name: Wall
symbols.gloss: a masonry wall closing off part of the scene
symbols.declared_text: enclosure, protection, limit

attestations.note: the Sun: the child rides 'beyond a wall' (Waite 1911)

symbols.name: Gate or threshold
symbols.gloss: a doorway, gate or passage between two pillars or towers
symbols.declared_text: passage, initiation, the point of crossing

attestations.note: the Moon: towers flanking the way; Death: the gate of the rising sun (Waite 1911)

symbols.name: Bridge
symbols.gloss: a bridge spanning water
symbols.declared_text: crossing, connection between two states

attestations.note: Five of Cups: 'a bridge leading to a small keep' (Waite 1911)

symbols.name: Rose
symbols.gloss: a rose flower, often white or red
symbols.declared_text: desire, passion, purity (white rose)

attestations.note: the Fool's white rose; the Magician's roses; Death's banner (Waite 1911)

symbols.name: Lily
symbols.gloss: a lily flower
symbols.declared_text: purity of thought, innocence

attestations.note: the Magician: 'roses and lilies' (Waite 1911)

symbols.name: Key
symbols.gloss: one or two keys, often crossed
symbols.declared_text: access, hidden knowledge unlocked, authority

attestations.note: the Hierophant: 'the crossed keys' (Waite 1911)

symbols.name: Ship
symbols.gloss: a sailing vessel on water
symbols.declared_text: voyage, trade, movement away

attestations.note: Two and Three of Wands; Six of Swords (Waite 1911)

symbols.name: Garden
symbols.gloss: cultivated plants, wheat or a walled garden
symbols.declared_text: fruitfulness, abundance, cultivated growth

attestations.note: the Empress: 'a field of corn is ripening' (Waite 1911)

symbols.name: Elder
symbols.gloss: an aged figure with white or grey hair or beard
symbols.declared_text: age, accumulated knowledge, authority of time

attestations.note: the Hermit; the Hierophant; the Emperor (Waite 1911)

symbols.name: Rider
symbols.gloss: a figure mounted on a horse
symbols.declared_text: arrival, force in motion, message

attestations.note: Death 'rides a horse'; the Sun's child rider; the four Knights (Waite 1911)

symbols.name: Falling figure
symbols.gloss: a human figure falling headlong
symbols.declared_text: sudden loss of position, catastrophe

attestations.note: the Tower: 'two figures falling' (Waite 1911)

symbols.name: Blindfold
symbols.gloss: a figure whose eyes are bound
symbols.declared_text: not seeing, refusal or inability to look

attestations.note: Two of Swords; Eight of Swords (Waite 1911)

symbols.name: Bandage or binding
symbols.gloss: cloth binding a figure's body
symbols.declared_text: restriction, being held

attestations.note: Eight of Swords: 'a woman, bound and hoodwinked' (Waite 1911)

symbols.name: Hourglass
symbols.gloss: a sand timer
symbols.declared_text: measured time, waiting

attestations.note: rare in Smith 1909 — no exemplar; the Hermit carries a lantern, not an hourglass

symbols.name: Pentacle
symbols.gloss: a disc or coin bearing a five-pointed star
symbols.declared_text: material value, the tangible, earned reward

attestations.note: the Magician's table: 'the four elements… pentacle' (Waite 1911); the whole suit of Pentacles

symbols.name: Throne
symbols.gloss: a seat of authority, often stone
symbols.declared_text: established authority, stability

attestations.note: the Emperor 'seated on a throne' (Waite 1911)

symbols.name: Serpent
symbols.gloss: a snake
symbols.declared_text: knowledge, temptation, cyclic renewal

attestations.note: the Lovers: 'the serpent… about the tree' (Waite 1911); the Wheel's Typhon

symbols.name: Cross
symbols.gloss: a cross emblem on clothing, a banner or a sceptre
symbols.declared_text: faith, doctrine, sacrifice

attestations.note: the Hierophant's triple cross; Judgement's banner; the High Priestess's solar cross (Waite 1911)

symbols.name: Rain
symbols.gloss: falling rain or a downpour
symbols.declared_text: sorrow, cleansing by loss

attestations.note: Three of Swords: 'rain falling' (Waite 1911)

symbols.name: Sunrise or sunset
symbols.gloss: the sun at the horizon
symbols.declared_text: transition of a cycle: a new day or a day ending

attestations.note: Death: 'the sun of immortality' rising between the towers; Temperance's path to the crowned sun (Waite 1911)
